entries.en: Redesigned Search (Grep) tool with new tool input parameters and features
entries.zh: 重新设计了搜索（Grep）工具，带有新的输入参数和功能

entries.en: Updated prompt input undo to Ctrl+\_ to avoid breaking existing Ctrl+U behavior, matching zsh's undo shortcut
entries.zh: 提示输入框的撤销改为 Ctrl+\_，以免破坏现有的 Ctrl+U 行为，与 zsh 的撤销快捷键保持一致

entries.en: Disabled IDE diffs for notebook files, fixing "Timeout waiting after 1000ms" error
entries.zh: 禁用笔记本文件的 IDE 差异，修复“1000 毫秒后超时等待”错误

entries.en: Fixed config file corruption issue by enforcing atomic writes
entries.zh: 通过强制执行原子写入修复了配置文件损坏问题

entries.en: Stop Hooks: Fixed transcript path after /clear and fixed triggering when loop ends with tool call
entries.zh: Stop 钩子：修复了 `/clear` 后的转录路径问题，以及循环以工具调用结束时的触发问题

entries.en: Custom slash commands: Restored namespacing in command names based on subdirectories. For example, .claude/commands/frontend/component.md is now /frontend:component, not /component.
entries.zh: 自定义斜杠命令：根据子目录恢复命令名称中的命名空间。例如，.claude/commands/frontend/component.md 现在是 /frontend:component，而不是 /component。
